The '''''Procurer''''' was a [[Lucrehulk-class battleship/Legends|''Lucrehulk''-class battleship]] that served as [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Mar Tuuk/Legends|Mar Tuuk's]] [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]] during the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]' [[Battle of Ryloth/Legends|blockade and invasion]] of [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]].<ref name="CWT" /> It was destroyed when [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] rammed the [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Defender/Legends|''Defender'']] into it, paving the way for a Republic attempt to liberate Ryloth.<ref name="SoR" />

{{Ship-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Defender_Venator.png|thumb|left|250px|The [[Defender/Legends|''Defender'']] rams the ''Procurer''.]]
The ''Procurer'' was first identified by name when represented as a miniature in the ''[[Clone Wars Tactics]]'' expansion of the ''[[Star Wars PocketModel TCG]]'', a game used as a promotional vehicle to preview ships and characters from upcoming episodes of the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' television series. Although ''Clone Wars Tactics'' identifies it as a [[Lucrehulk-class battleship/Legends|''Lucrehulk''-class battleship]],<ref name="CWT" /> it bears the unmistakable communications array that is indicative of a Droid Control Ship.
